prompts.name: Image Description
prompts.description: Provides a detailed description of an image
prompts.template: Analyze this image and provide a {{detail_level}} description. Focus on {{focus_area}}.

defaultVariables.focus_area: all visual elements, composition, colors, and subjects

examples.description: Quick description of the main subject

prompts.name: Create an updated image with details from the existing image
prompts.description: Provides an updated image, that is using items of the original
prompts.template: Create a {{type_of_shot}} shot featuring an AI-generated model with fresh, youthful natural makeup in soft, dewy tones. The composition should prominently showcase {{focus_area}} as the focal point, with the model's face artfully angled to remain only partially visible, adding intrigue and emphasis to {{focus_area}}. Set within a clean, modern studio environment with soft, diffused lighting that balances professional elegance with a subtle playful energy. Incorporate gentle shadows and highlights to add dimension. The overall mood should feel approachable yet polished, with a color palette of neutral tones accented by warm, inviting hues. Final output as a 9:16 vertical image.

defaultVariables.focus_area: the main item of the attached image

variables.focus_area: the main item of the attached image

examples.description: Create an updated image with details from the existing image

prompts.name: Text Extraction (OCR)
prompts.description: Extracts all visible text from an image
prompts.template: Extract all text visible in this image. Format the output as {{format}}. Preserve the {{layout}} of the text.

prompts.name: Color Extraction
prompts.description: Identifies and extracts dominant colors from an image
prompts.template: Analyze this image and identify the {{count}} most dominant colors. Provide the colors as {{format}} and include {{additional_info}}.

defaultVariables.format: hex color codes with color names
defaultVariables.additional_info: the approximate percentage of each color in the image

examples.description: Extract top 3 colors with mood analysis

prompts.name: Object Detection
prompts.description: Detects and identifies objects in an image
prompts.template: Identify all {{object_type}} in this image. For each object, provide {{details}}. {{confidence_instruction}}

defaultVariables.details: the name, approximate location, and size
defaultVariables.confidence_instruction: Include your confidence level for each detection.

variables.details: count, positions, and any visible attributes
variables.confidence_instruction: Only include detections with high confidence.

examples.description: Detect people and faces with high confidence

prompts.name: Image Classification
prompts.template: Classify this image into relevant categories. Consider {{aspects}} and provide {{output_format}}.

defaultVariables.aspects: subject matter, style, mood, and context
defaultVariables.output_format: a list of categories with confidence scores

prompts.name: Scene Understanding
prompts.description: Provides comprehensive understanding of a scene
prompts.template: Analyze this scene and describe: {{elements}}. Provide insights about {{context}}.

defaultVariables.elements: the setting, objects, people, activities, and atmosphere
defaultVariables.context: the likely context, time of day, location type, and any notable details

variables.context: outdoor/indoor setting and time of day

prompts.name: Accessibility Description
prompts.description: Creates detailed alt-text descriptions for accessibility
prompts.template: Create an accessibility-friendly description of this image. Include {{elements}} in a {{style}} manner. Maximum length: {{max_length}}.

defaultVariables.elements: all important visual information, text, and context
